messages:
ana_security: Heads-up — Private Data Shield (PDS) v1.0 is GA for Private/VPC and Dedicated customers as of today. PDS bundles egress controls, attestable audit snapshots, and an agent-side data classification hook to help customers meet tighter data residency and exfiltration requirements. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/pds-v1 :tada:

ana_security: Key notes —
- Default: opt-in for existing Private tenants (we will not enable without customer confirmation).
- New Private signups get PDS available in the console under Security -> Data Shield.
- Compliance: includes a SOC2 addendum template and HLD for auditors.

ana_security: Rollout plan (high level):
1) Today: GA announcement + doc publish.
2) 48h: CSE outreach to active Private customers flagged with high-sensitivity workloads.
3) 2 weeks: controlled enablement for pilot list (5 customers) with close SRE/SEC support.
4) 6 weeks: wider availability after pilot feedback and minor fixes.

ana_security: Customer readiness checklist (for CSE/Sales/SEs):
- Confirm customer acceptance of egress policy changes and KMS integration.
- Share the audit bundle export doc and run a dry-run with their auditor.
- If on-prem: ensure agent v3.1+ applied (required for local classification hooks).
- If Private-VPC: check route tables for agent outbound reachability to 10.0.0.0/24 to allow attestation callbacks.

michelle_product: Nice work. A couple quick Qs: migration path for existing Private customers? Is there any change to billing?

raj_infra: Migration is manual opt-in. For on-prem customers we provide an enable script; for VPC we add a toggle in the Console and a REST API. No billing delta for PDS itself this quarter; premium compliance package will be an add-on later. Sample enable CLI for on-prem:
```
# onprem agent host
curl -X POST https://cid.redwood.local/api/v1/agent/enable-pds
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
  -d '{"agent_version": "3.1.0", "kms_key": "projects/prod-kms/keys/pds-key"}'
```

raj_infra: For Dedicated customers we push a config snippet they approve via support ticket.

deploy-bot: Deployment update: PDS feature flags turned on in staging/us-west1 and staging/eu-west1 at 2026-03-22T18:12Z. Canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-23 02:00Z.

support_lead: Please add a short-runbook for common support paths (enable failure, audit bundle missing fields, agent upgrade drift). I'll take ownership of the first draft.

ana_security: @support_lead thanks — assigning to you. I also scheduled 30m enablement + Q&A for CSE and Support tomorrow 10:30 PT (calendar invite sent). Meeting resources: https://redwood.internal/wiki/pds-enable-guide

jordan_cto: Huge milestone — congrats team. Please add a one-page exec summary for the board deck (focus: customer demand, risk mitigations, revenue upside from compliance add-on).

michelle_product: Will coordinate the exec summary and the pilot success metrics we need to track (time-to-enable, audit pass rate, incidents avoided).

ana_security: Quick note on telemetry: PDS generates an attestable audit bundle on request — we do NOT send customer payloads to telemetry by default. Telemetry collects only metadata (timestamps, operation success/failure). Customers can opt-in to share bundles for Redwood-run validation.

michelle_product: ACK — will update the product FAQ with that language. :white_check_mark:

ana_security: If any blockers (legal, sales, docs, eng), reply here and I’ll route. Otherwise we'll begin CSE outreach in 2 hours.

raj_infra: No blockers from infra side, SRE will monitor canaries.

jordan_cto: Thanks all. Small ask: capture any customer asks for stronger key isolation (HSM-backed customer keys) in this thread — we'll prioritize in roadmap if demand is high.

michelle_product: Noted — I'll log requests in the pilot tracker.

ana_security: End of thread update: initial outreach batch started at 2026-03-22T20:35Z. Will post pilot list and first feedback within 72h. :rocket:
